product_metadata.title: KitchenCraft KCCURL Butter Curler Tool, Stainless Steel, 18 x 5 cm, Black/Silver
features: Why spend hours struggling to cut butter curls with a knife, when this handy tool makes perfect curls in seconds
Simply draw it across chilled butter to make a beautiful decorative curl. Or use it to cut chocolate swirls to garnish desserts
Enjoy professional results without forking out for individual butter portions! Ideal for caterers, restaurateurs and dinner party hosts
Made of rigid stainless steel, with an ergonomic plastic handle for easy, comfortable curling
description: Putting on a special party? Make sure that even the butter looks beautiful with this handy butter curler tool from KitchenCraft. It’s a really quick and easy way to turn chilled blocks of butter into gorgeous decorative curls. It’s also fantastic for creating chocolate curls to garnish desserts. However you use it, it’s sure to provide impressive results - ideal for dinner parties, buffets and special events.
